subject_session: 15 rats, 96 standard-box sessions; example rat 11265 ses 3020601

headline_stat.name: fraction of MEC units classified as grid cells (gridness > shuffled 95th pct)

stated_limitation: The gridness score is a single scalar and, as the unfiltered gallery in fig07_grid_gallery.png shows, a small number of high-scoring units have band-like rather than hexagonal autocorrelograms. Grid spacing is estimated from the six autocorrelogram peaks nearest the centre, so it is least reliable for cells whose spacing approaches the size of the box... The head-direction criterion uses the same shuffling procedure as the gridness criterion and is permissive; the head-direction fractions should be read as "significantly directionally modulated", not as a census of classical head-direction cells.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000582 (Sargolini/Moser) is the canonical dorsocaudal MEC grid-cell dataset with freely foraging rats in the standard box.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, LED-midpoint position, gap interpolation, speed filtering, per-session extent calibration, 100-spike minimum, and 1 m box selection are all explicit and defensible.
justification.analysis: Standard occupancy-normalized rate maps, unbiased spatial autocorrelogram, expanding-annulus gridness, circular-shift shuffle null, and split-half stability are the correct methods with the required control present.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (28.4%, spacing 49.6 cm IQR 42.7-66.4, 71% conjunctive, stability 0.71 vs 0.40, threshold 0.665, layer breakdown) reproduces exactly from the committed CSVs and is internally consistent.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes, show unmistakable hexagonal lattices and a well-separated shuffle null, and the gallery honestly shows unfiltered top cells including imperfect band-like ones.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to the evidence and the write-up explicitly flags band-like high scorers, spacing-estimate limits, the permissive HD criterion, and that the conjunctive fraction is not an unbiased MEC estimate.
justification.verdict: A thorough, reproducible, well-controlled demonstration of grid cells that I would take and move on from.
